summary: Multilingual mobile wallet platform for personal and business users: web app, .NET backend APIs and the company's landing site.
highlights: Built the wallet web app with Next.js and Node.js: transactions, cashback tracking, virtual cards, and user, corporate and admin dashboards with content management, analytics and support tools.
Developed REST APIs in the .NET backend (C#, Entity Framework, PostgreSQL).
Built the landing site with Next.js and Tailwind CSS; set up Nginx on Ubuntu and GitHub Actions CI/CD for automated deployments.
